entities.name: Lina Guérin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lina Guérin is a French rugby union player. She was a member of the France women's national rugby sevens team to the 2016 Summer Olympics. She has played in 22 matches in the Women's Sevens Series so far, made 12 tries and scored 60 points.
